source.paper: unknown Spanish-language daily (Guatemala City zones: Santa Barbara, Chinautla appear)

summary: A creative ad that bends a real classifieds page into a 3D room. Underneath it is a dense Spanish-language classifieds page whose classifications are marked by black rounded number tabs.

frame.masthead: Big section number (3) in a black square with VIVIENDA, and a classification index down the left edge.

headers.notes: Large white numerals in a black rounded tab, category name in tiny caps beneath. Very scannable.

units.notes: Agate liners, bold caps place-name or item lead.

notes: Treat as reference: the 3D fold is an ad concept, but the number-tab header is a strong, distinct device worth its own header kind.
If more Latin American pages turn up, this may anchor a 'numbered-tab' family.
